title: project.format plan
description: Every document the project names and whether it is already canonical. A `--check` run and a fixing run are the same computation, which is what makes them provably agree rather than agree by habit.

sha256.description: Digest of the canonical bytes. Present for every document, formatted or not: it is what says two runs of the formatter produced the same answer.

canonical.description: Whether the file on disk already is canonical form.

written.description: Documents actually rewritten. Empty for a prepared plan, and empty for a commit that found everything already canonical.
